command:
set -eu
password_hash='$6$InfraSetSSH9$2NeDRQj1s46Scokieo5x3m.XkVG6jaIsLCQrjh2tyOmQ1e8sv.tci3ZOPRu1KcpY9VfylfGOPSvPAywpFSg.41'

if ! getent group ssh-access >/dev/null; then
  groupadd --gid 24000 ssh-access
fi
test "$(getent group ssh-access | cut -d: -f3)" = 24000

if ! id opsadmin >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  useradd --create-home --uid 24001 --user-group --shell /bin/bash --comment 'Prepared SSH administrator' opsadmin
fi
if ! id contractor >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  useradd --create-home --uid 24002 --user-group --shell /bin/bash --comment 'Prepared restricted contractor' contractor
fi
usermod --append --groups ssh-access opsadmin
if id -nG contractor | tr ' ' '\n' | grep -qx ssh-access; then
  gpasswd --delete contractor ssh-access
fi
usermod --password "$password_hash" opsadmin
usermod --password "$password_hash" contractor

install -d -m 0700 -o opsadmin -g opsadmin /home/opsadmin/.ssh
install -d -m 0700 -o contractor -g contractor /home/contractor/.ssh
for user in opsadmin contractor; do
  key_file="/home/$user/.ssh/authorized_keys"
  touch "$key_file"
  grep -qxF "$CLUSTER_SSH_PUBKEY" "$key_file" || printf '%s\n' "$CLUSTER_SSH_PUBKEY" >> "$key_file"
  chown "$user:$user" "$key_file"
  chmod 0600 "$key_file"
done

install -d -m 0700 /root/.ssh
touch /root/.ssh/authorized_keys
grep -qxF "$CLUSTER_SSH_PUBKEY" /root/.ssh/authorized_keys || printf '%s\n' "$CLUSTER_SSH_PUBKEY" >> /root/.ssh/authorized_keys
chmod 0600 /root/.ssh/authorized_keys

printf '%s\n' 'prepared opsadmin state: preserve' > /home/opsadmin/prepared-state.txt
printf '%s\n' 'prepared contractor state: preserve' > /home/contractor/prepared-state.txt
chown opsadmin:opsadmin /home/opsadmin/prepared-state.txt
chown contractor:contractor /home/contractor/prepared-state.txt
chmod 0640 /home/opsadmin/prepared-state.txt /home/contractor/prepared-state.txt

install -d -m 0700 /var/lib/infraset-ssh-fixture
printf '%s\n' "$CLUSTER_SSH_PUBKEY" > /var/lib/infraset-ssh-fixture/access-key.pub
{
  getent shadow opsadmin | cut -d: -f1,2
  getent shadow contractor | cut -d: -f1,2
} | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1 > /var/lib/infraset-ssh-fixture/shadow.sha256
chmod 0600 /var/lib/infraset-ssh-fixture/access-key.pub /var/lib/infraset-ssh-fixture/shadow.sha256

restorecon -RF /root/.ssh /home/opsadmin /home/contractor /var/lib/infraset-ssh-fixture
sshd -t
systemctl enable --now sshd.service

set -eu
if ! id sshprobe >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  useradd --create-home --uid 24010 --user-group --shell /bin/bash --comment 'Prepared SSH validation identity' sshprobe
fi
install -d -m 0700 -o sshprobe -g sshprobe /home/sshprobe/.ssh
printf '%s\n' "$CLUSTER_SSH_PRIVKEY" > /home/sshprobe/.ssh/id_ed25519
printf '%s\n' "$CLUSTER_SSH_PUBKEY" > /home/sshprobe/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub
printf '%s\n' 'Ssh-Probe_9!' > /home/sshprobe/.ssh/password-probe
cat > /home/sshprobe/.ssh/askpass <<'INFRASET_ASKPASS'
#!/bin/sh
exec cat /home/sshprobe/.ssh/password-probe
INFRASET_ASKPASS
chown -R sshprobe:sshprobe /home/sshprobe/.ssh
chmod 0600 /home/sshprobe/.ssh/id_ed25519 /home/sshprobe/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub /home/sshprobe/.ssh/password-probe
chmod 0700 /home/sshprobe/.ssh/askpass
command -v ssh >/dev/null
command -v ssh-keyscan >/dev/null
command -v setsid >/dev/null

set -eu
if ! id sshprobe >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  useradd --create-home --uid 24010 --user-group --shell /bin/bash --comment 'Prepared untrusted SSH validation identity' sshprobe
fi
install -d -m 0700 -o sshprobe -g sshprobe /home/sshprobe/.ssh
printf '%s\n' "$CLUSTER_SSH_PRIVKEY" > /home/sshprobe/.ssh/id_ed25519
printf '%s\n' "$CLUSTER_SSH_PUBKEY" > /home/sshprobe/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub
chown -R sshprobe:sshprobe /home/sshprobe/.ssh
chmod 0600 /home/sshprobe/.ssh/id_ed25519 /home/sshprobe/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub
command -v ssh >/dev/null
command -v ssh-keyscan >/dev/null

set -eu
printf '%s\n' "$CLUSTER_HOSTS" >> /etc/hosts
tmp="$(mktemp)"
trap 'rm -f "$tmp"' EXIT
attempt=0
while ! { ssh-keyscan -T 3 node1 > "$tmp" 2>/dev/null && test -s "$tmp"; }; do
  attempt=$((attempt + 1))
  test "$attempt" -lt 10
  sleep 2
done
test -s "$tmp"
sort -u "$tmp" > /home/sshprobe/.ssh/known_hosts
chown sshprobe:sshprobe /home/sshprobe/.ssh/known_hosts
chmod 0600 /home/sshprobe/.ssh/known_hosts

set -eu
printf '%s\n' "$CLUSTER_HOSTS" >> /etc/hosts
tmp="$(mktemp)"
trap 'rm -f "$tmp"' EXIT
attempt=0
while ! { ssh-keyscan -T 3 node1 > "$tmp" 2>/dev/null && test -s "$tmp"; }; do
  attempt=$((attempt + 1))
  test "$attempt" -lt 10
  sleep 2
done
test -s "$tmp"
sort -u "$tmp" > /home/sshprobe/.ssh/known_hosts
chown sshprobe:sshprobe /home/sshprobe/.ssh/known_hosts
chmod 0600 /home/sshprobe/.ssh/known_hosts

set -eu
for user in opsadmin contractor root; do
  runuser -u sshprobe -- ssh \
    -o BatchMode=yes \
    -o IdentitiesOnly=yes \
    -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes \
    -o UserKnownHostsFile=/home/sshprobe/.ssh/known_hosts \
    -i /home/sshprobe/.ssh/id_ed25519 \
    "$user@node1" 'id -un' | grep -qx "$user"
done

set -eu
runuser -u sshprobe -- ssh \
  -o BatchMode=yes \
  -o IdentitiesOnly=yes \
  -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes \
  -o UserKnownHostsFile=/home/sshprobe/.ssh/known_hosts \
  -i /home/sshprobe/.ssh/id_ed25519 \
  opsadmin@node1 'id -un' | grep -qx opsadmin
